text: i already decided. make the change. no one is going to have a broken heart
resolution: Per the user's 'dont export shit from files if it needs exporting it needs its own component': extracted the shared bits that used to be exported out of the IsoAuthor.tsx grab-bag into their OWN modules — buildArmed.ts (the Armed type + sameArmed helper, shared by the map, the rail, and the properties panel) and CatalogRail.tsx (the rail's catalog menu). index.tsx, LoaderIsoView, and RightPanel now import from those dedicated files; IsoAuthor.tsx was deleted. That grab-bag export pattern is exactly how the second build pane diverged unnoticed, so splitting it prevents recurrence. Also removed the now-obsolete IsoAuthor native-render test and fixed stale comments (controls.ts, index.tsx). Bundle verified. This commit also carried two other sessions' in-flight working-tree edits in index.tsx (armedFocus) and RightPanel (renderTick diag) since I had to edit those files — authorized by the user. SHA f76513e8a.
